local_bottleneck: CAC incorporation (CLBG) then NCMM/NGO Bureau registration; foreign NGOs also need SCUML and an Interior ORC

foreign_donor_restriction: Foreign NGOs need NCMM registration; SCUML registration mandatory; Interior Ministry ORC for foreign-funded NGOs

local_bottleneck: Foreign NGOs need exercise authorization; local associations declared at electronic registry; French filings
